mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for constructing a lagoon-style pool?

acceptedAnswer.text: The construction timeline for a lagoon-style pool generally ranges from 12 to 24 weeks, though this can vary based on the project's scale and specific features. Key phases include design and permitting (4-8 weeks), excavation and structural work (4-6 weeks), plumbing and electrical installation (2-3 weeks), rockwork and landscaping (3-5 weeks), and final finishes and curing (2-4 weeks). Unexpected weather conditions or material lead times can also influence the overall schedule. We provide a detailed project timeline after finalizing the design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Construction of a lagoon-style pool typically takes 12 to 24 weeks, influenced by design complexity, weather, and material availability.
